settings.heading: FLEXIBLE FINANCING FOR FINE JEWELRY
settings.description: We believe everyone should feel confident purchasing fine jewelry. That's why we've partnered with Affirm™ to offer transparent financing options that let you pay over time. Whether you're purchasing an engagement ring, buying a gift, or designing a custom piece, Affirm makes it easy to choose a plan that fits your needs.

settings.title: What do I need to use Affirm?
settings.content: To use Affirm at checkout, you'll need to be 18 or older (19 in certain states), have a valid U.S. or APO/FPO/DPO address, and a U.S. mobile phone number capable of receiving SMS. You'll also be asked to provide your full name, email, date of birth, and the last 4 digits of your Social Security number to verify your identity. Affirm will run a soft credit check to determine your eligibility, which won't affect your credit score. Approval depends on factors including your credit history, the purchase amount, and your payment history with Affirm.

settings.title: How do I make payments?
settings.content:
You can make or schedule payments at affirm.com or in the Affirm app for iOS or
Android. Affirm will send you email and text reminders before payments are due.

settings.title: Can I pay off my purchase early?
settings.content: Absolutely! Affirm does not charge a penalty for paying off your balance early.

settings.title: Does checking my rate affect my credit score?
settings.content:
No. Affirm allows you to check your rate and pre-qualify without a hard credit inquiry. This means you can explore financing options and create an account without impacting your credit score.

Unlike hard inquiries, soft inquiries do not affect your credit score. They may appear on your credit report depending on the bureau, but they are only visible to you and do not impact your credit profile.

settings.title: Can I finance a custom ring?
settings.content: Yes. Affirm is available for all MiaDonna purchases, including fully custom designs.

settings.title: Are there hidden fees?
settings.content: No. Affirm is transparent–your terms are clearly displayed before you complete your purchase.

settings.title: Can I return an item I bought with Affirm?
settings.content: Yes – you can return an item you bought with Affirm.

settings.title: Can I use Affirm to purchase a loose lab-grown diamond?
settings.content: Affirm financing is not available for loose lab-grown diamond purchases. However, Affirm can be used for nearly all other MiaDonna pieces, including engagement rings, made-to-order jewelry, custom designs, and ready-to-ship styles. If you're designing a custom engagement ring or setting that includes a lab-grown diamond, the complete piece is eligible for Affirm financing
